packageRules.description: Use version tags for GitHub-authored actions; retain digest pinning for third-party actions.
tonic, tonic-prost, tonic-prost-build and prost generate and consume the same bindings, so they must move together.
CI compiles and tests both backends but cannot exercise real display or audio output; these updates are verified on the device (hardware) or in the emulator.

alsa 0.12 requires alsa-sys 0.6, while rodio -> cpal still depends on alsa 0.11 (alsa-sys 0.4). Both alsa-sys versions declare links = "alsa", and cargo resolves the union of the target-specific dependencies, so only one may exist. Lift this once cpal moves to alsa 0.12.
Flag major updates for closer review.
The led-image-api submodule reference is bumped deliberately together with regenerated bindings.
